The language of MZGram\'s own settings and features. Same as Telegram: Telegram\'s language when MZGram has it, otherwise English. System: the phone\'s language when MZGram has it, otherwise English.
Show exact counts of views, reactions and members: 4777 instead of 4.8K.
An empty chat shows only its title, without the suggested sticker to send.
In channels where you cannot post, hides the bottom bar with the mute button.
Adds Copy Photo to the menu of a downloaded photo, so it can be pasted into other apps.
Adds Set a reminder to the menu of a message you can forward. It forwards the message to Saved Messages as a scheduled message at the time you pick, which then notifies you.
Adds Forward without sender next to Forward. It opens the usual forward flow with sender names already hidden, so the message is sent as your own.

In chats and channels whose owner restricted saving content, you can forward, save and copy messages and media and take screenshots, like anywhere else. Telegram does not forward such messages, so they are sent as new messages without the original sender; media not downloaded yet is downloaded first.
When messages are deleted, the box that deletes them for the other side too is already ticked; untick it to delete them only for yourself. Telegram leaves it unticked.
Scans the photo on the device when you open its menu; if it holds a QR code, QR Code appears and shows the link or text.
Adds Details to the message menu: ids, sender, dates, forward source, file, media and data center of a message. Long press a value to copy it.
Adds Open in... to the menu of a video (Android 8 and newer). It opens the video in another app, streaming it if it is not downloaded yet.
Adds Repeat to the message menu. It forwards the same message into this chat again, or sends its text or sticker again where forwarding is not allowed.
Adds Save Message to the menu of a message you can forward. It forwards the message to Saved Messages in one tap.
Adds Delete Downloaded File to the menu of a downloaded file or video. The file stays in the chat and can be downloaded again.
A video in the media viewer pauses when the app goes to the background or the screen turns off, and resumes when you return.
Confirm voice and round video messages
Releasing the record button shows the recorded voice or round video for review, with an explicit Send, instead of sending it right away.
Media preview on chat avatar long-press
If the last message in a chat is a photo or video, long-pressing its avatar in the chat list shows that media instead of opening Chat Preview.
Videos that come in several qualities play in the original one, which uses more data.
Removes the tab bar under the chat list. My Profile, Contacts, Calls and Settings move to the chat list menu, where your accounts are too. Takes effect after a restart.
Accounts in the chat list menu

The menu of the three dots at the top of the chat list ends with your accounts: a tap switches to one at once, without Settings. The current account is marked, the others show their unread count, and Add Account is there while there is room for one.
Shows the chat folder tabs at the bottom of the chat list, within reach of your thumb, instead of under the search field. Takes effect after a restart.
When you scroll a profile up, the avatar melts into the top of the screen. When off, it simply fades out.
On Android 14 and newer, the back gesture previews the previous screen before you release it. Takes effect after a restart.
Removes the stories row from the chat list. Stories in profiles stay. Takes effect after a restart.

Removes the camera tile from the photo and video gallery of the attach menu: the gallery starts with your first photo and the camera does not start. The in-app camera then cannot be opened from the attach menu. Applies to chats opened after the change.
The camera tile in the attach menu no longer shows a live camera preview; the camera starts when you tap the tile.
Pulling the chat list down past the archive row opens the archive.
Show a confirmation before a voice or video call starts.
Message times show seconds, such as 12:34:56. Applies to screens opened after the change.
Other users no longer see that you read their message or that you are typing. Your own unread counters still work as usual.

Holds an outgoing message (12 seconds, longer for photos/videos/files) before actually sending it, so composing and sending right away does not make you look online. Not recommended on an unreliable connection: a delayed message can still be waiting to send if the app closes or the network drops in the meantime.
Sends every outgoing message without a notification sound for the recipient while ghost mode is on, regardless of the per-message \"send without sound\" option.
Before opening a story for the first time (not when swiping to the next one), asks whether to turn ghost mode on first, so viewing it does not mark it as seen.
Ghost mode is off. Viewing this story will mark it as seen. Turn ghost mode on first?
Permanently deletes every deleted/edited message archived so far, and all its saved media, in every chat.
Some archive files could not be deleted. MZGram will try again at the next start.
This permanently deletes the whole local archive of deleted and edited messages, including saved media. This cannot be undone. Continue?
Export saves the archive database as a file you choose where to put. Import replaces the current archive with a previously exported file (media files are not included).
This replaces the current local archive with the picked file. This cannot be undone. Continue?
Stops sponsored (ad) messages in channels, and the promo/proxy banner in the chat list, from being requested or shown.
Removes stacked Unicode combining marks (Zalgo-style corrupted text) from names and chat titles shown to you.

In every private chat, group, channel and secret chat, keeps a local copy of another person\'s message before it is deleted, and every earlier revision of an edited one. Your own messages are not saved.
A bot\'s messages follow From bots in every chat; other messages follow the kind of chat: a private chat, a group or a channel. Turning one off stops new saves; what is already kept stays.

Files of saved messages are copied to Downloads/MZGram/Saved Attachments, of any size and with no total limit. Formatting and reactions are kept with the text; chats with bots are saved only while their switch is on.
Clears Telegram\'s cache on this device: messages, the chat list and the rest of the local database. They load again from the server. The MZGram archive is not cleared.

This clears Telegram\'s local cache: cached messages and the chat list, which then load again from the server. The MZGram archive (saved deleted and edited messages, and the Saved Attachments folder) is NOT cleared; use "Clear archive" for that. A message deleted on the server before it is loaded again is not saved.
The marks are shown before the time of another person\'s deleted or edited message; any text, leave empty for none. Deleted messages kept in the chat are drawn at 75% opacity.
Tap a revision to copy its text.
No saved revisions for this message.

Notifications come through a UnifiedPush distributor: the built-in Google FCM or an app such as ntfy, microG or Sunup. Telegram\'s own Google push does not work in MZGram builds, so with this off, notifications in the background depend on Telegram\'s own connection (Background Connection or Keep-Alive Service in Notifications and Sounds).
Waiting for the distributor to answer.
Choose a distributor to receive notifications.
No distributor: install ntfy, Sunup or another UnifiedPush distributor app, or Google Play Services or microG for the built-in Google FCM.

The gateway cannot read your notifications: the keys to them stay on this device. It sees the address of your distributor, and the time and size of each notification. You can set your own gateway. Without a gateway Telegram sends straight to the distributor; notifications then cannot be decrypted, they only wake the app up and it fetches new messages itself.
This address cannot be used: it must start with https:// and must not contain a name or password.

Notifications are delivered by Google Play Services (or microG) on this device, and the gateway signs them for it. There is no Google library in the app and notifications stay encrypted, but Google sees that a notification was sent and when, and Google Play Services or microG must stay installed. Any other distributor keeps Google out of the path.

Google FCM accepts only notifications signed with the key of the gateway they come from, so this key must match the gateway above. Notifications go to %1$s. With your own gateway change both together; otherwise leave the defaults. The built-in Google FCM always goes through the gateway.
This is not a VAPID public key: 87 characters of base64url, an uncompressed P-256 key.
URL prefix for the UnifiedPush gateway.
No notification has reached this device since the counters were last reset.
Received since the last reset: %1$s (decrypted %2$s, wake-ups %3$s, decrypt failed %4$s)
no answer from Google Play Services or microG for %1$s s
MZGram only reads these settings and never changes them. Tap a row to open the screen where you can change it yourself.

As MIUI reports them. Without Autostart a push cannot wake MZGram up, and without pop-up windows the call screen cannot open. Also set Battery saver to No restrictions and lock MZGram in the recent apps.
The log has the device model, these checks and the recent push events, in English. It has no push token and no keys.
This screen cannot be opened on this device.
Messages from Google Play Services or microG: %1$s
no answer from Telegram for %1$s s
turned off in the system settings
Sending a test push through the gateway…
The test push came back after %1$s s: the way from the gateway through the distributor to this app works.
The gateway took the test push (HTTP %1$s), but it did not come back within %2$s s: it got lost between the gateway, the distributor and this app.

The gateway refused the test push (HTTP 403). The default gateway takes pushes only from Telegram\'s servers, so a test from the phone cannot pass it; Registration with Telegram and the events above show what Telegram did.
The gateway refused the test push: HTTP %1$s.
The test push could not be sent: %1$s
There is nothing to send to yet: the distributor has not given an endpoint, or the gateway is turned off.

Every few hours MZGram looks for its latest stable release on GitHub and shows a bar at the bottom of the screen when it is newer. Update downloads the APK of that release from GitHub, checks its SHA-256 and installs it; Android may ask you to confirm. If the file does not pass the check, nothing is installed. Turning this off turns off the update too. Check for updates looks at once and says what it found, also when this is off. The update check of Telegram itself is off: it offers the official app, which cannot update MZGram.
You have the latest version of MZGram
Could not check for updates. Check the connection and try again.
MZGram %1$s could not be downloaded. Check the connection and try again.
The MZGram %1$s file did not pass the SHA-256 check and was deleted. Nothing was installed.
Android did not install MZGram %1$s. Try again or install it from the release page.
To update itself, MZGram needs Android\'s permission to install apps. On the next screen turn on Allow from this source, come back and tap Update again.
Pinned in MZGram only: the server allows no more pinned chats, so this one is pinned on this device and not on your other devices.
Copying and forwarding is not allowed for this user.
Copying and forwarding is not allowed in this channel.
Copying and forwarding is not allowed in this group.
Ask an AI site about a message
Show \"Ask AI\" in the message menu
Sign out of every AI site in MZGram? Your Telegram accounts stay signed in.
Signed out of the AI sites.

Ask AI opens the chosen AI site in an MZGram window, with a sign-in of its own apart from Telegram\'s. No paid API is used: you sign in to the site with your own account. The text, your prompt and up to 10 photos and files go into the site\'s message, and you send it there yourself. Messages in chats that restrict copying have no Ask AI.

The text, the attachments and your prompt will go into the chat of %1$s, a service outside Telegram and MZGram, under the account you sign in with there. The site uploads attachments to its servers as soon as they are added, before you press Send; the text is sent only when you press Send. This warning is shown once.
The text is in the input field. Check it and press Send yourself.
No input field found. Sign in if the site asks, then press Insert text, or copy the text and paste it.
This Android System WebView cannot keep the AI sites apart from Telegram. Update Android System WebView, then try again. You can still copy the text.
The built-in browser cannot start on this device. Install or turn on Android System WebView, then try again.
A hidden row is gone from Telegram\'s Settings and from its search; nothing else changes.
video, GIFs, stickers, voice and music: %1$s
Attachments added: %1$s. Check the message on the site and press Send yourself.
To add the photos and files of the messages, press the site\'s own button for adding files: MZGram then shows them to choose from.
Tick the files to give the site, at most 10 at once.
Choose another file on this device
The site takes only photos here.
Files ready: %1$s. Press the site\'s button for adding files to choose them.
The site takes one file at a time: press its button for adding files again (%1$s left).
Buttons in the chat list menu
A button opens that AI site in MZGram\'s window, without a message.
Files up to this size are downloaded as soon as a message comes. When a message is deleted, a file up to 100 MB larger is downloaded then, if the server still gives it. Files saved earlier stay.
These numbers show how the limits work on this device. Link expired means the server no longer gives the file of a deleted message.
The ID of a user, bot, group or channel in its profile. Bot API puts -100 before the ID of a channel or supergroup and - before the ID of a group. Tap the ID to copy it.
A permanent notification keeps the connection, so that messages and calls come on time. For phones where messages come late. Uses more battery.
This phone limits MZGram in the background, so messages can come late. Reliable delivery keeps the connection. Tap to open its switch.
Links, drafts, previews and what the server learns
t.me and tg:// links show their address and ask before they open, so a hidden link cannot join a channel, start a bot or add a proxy in one tap.
The server is not told which trending sticker and emoji packs you looked at. They are marked viewed on this device only and can show as new again after a restart.

A link you type or paste is not sent to Telegram for a preview, so the server does not open it before you send the message. Messages then go without a preview. Previews in received messages still show.
Text you typed but did not send is not uploaded to Telegram and does not show on your other devices. Clearing a draft still removes an old copy from the cloud.
Protect voice messages on the lock screen

While the phone is locked, voice messages and round videos do not start or resume from the lock screen player or headset buttons, and their player hides the sender\'s name and photo. Music plays as usual.

Adds \"Ghost mode in this chat\" to a chat\'s menu: follow the switch above, always show reads and typing there, or never show them there even while ghost mode is off. The auto-delay and silent send follow the same choice.

Telegram does not show you your own last seen. This device notes when it last told Telegram you are online or offline and shows it here, for this account. People your privacy settings hide it from see \"recently\" instead.
Keep who read my messages in groups

Telegram lists who read your message only in small groups and only for about a week. Each time the message menu shows that list, it is kept on this device, and message menu > Details shows the readers and times later too.

A link like t.me/bot?start=code tells the bot which link brought you, and Telegram sends it by itself when you already have a chat with the bot. This asks first: start with the code, without it, or from another of your accounts, so the bot never sees this one. A repeat of the same start within a few seconds is dropped.

Telegram\'s CDN servers only know your account\'s permanent key, so every file from them carries the same key id that someone watching the network can use to link your downloads. Files are asked from Telegram\'s main servers instead. Large files can download slower.
Each account can have its own passcode for the app lock: entering it unlocks the app and opens that account. An account with its own passcode can be hidden from the account lists and notifications.
Account passcodes work with the app lock. Turn on Passcode Lock first; account passcodes are of the same kind (a 4-digit PIN or a password).

A hidden account is left out of Settings, the chat list menu and every account choice, and shows no notifications; only its own passcode on the lock screen opens it. The app passcode or the fingerprint opens a visible account. Turning off Account passcodes or Passcode Lock shows hidden accounts again.
This is the app passcode, choose another one
Another account already has this passcode
At least one account must stay visible

Adds \"Archive in this chat\" to a chat\'s menu: follow Keep messages above, always keep other people\'s deleted and edited messages there, or never keep them there. Save deleted messages and Save edit history still apply, and what was saved stays.
Reply to deleted as a quote

A reply whose original was deleted shows the copy kept in the archive instead of \"Deleted message\". The server has no deleted message to reply to, so with the second switch a reply to a kept deleted message is sent with its author and text as a quote at the top.
Deleted messages in the chat menu
Adds \"Deleted messages\" to a chat\'s menu: every message other people deleted there that the archive keeps, newest first, with search. Tap one to go to it in the chat, hold to copy its text.
The archive keeps no deleted messages of this chat.
No deleted messages with this text.
Tap a message to go to it in the chat, hold to copy its text.

When a chat leaves the chat list (deleted by the other side or by you, or left) or loses all its messages while the archive keeps deleted messages of it, it goes to Deleted chats. Telegram deletes the chat as usual; MZGram only remembers it.
Tap a chat to open it with its kept messages, hold to take it off this list. The messages stay in the archive.
Take %1$s off Deleted chats? Its kept messages stay in the archive.

Adds deleted and edited messages, deleted chats and last seen times from another client\'s message database (an SQLite file such as database-export.sqlite). What the archive has stays; your own messages are left out.
Pick the other client\'s message database. Its messages are added to the archive; nothing in the archive is replaced.
This file is not a message database the archive can read

A deleted message kept in the chat has no original on the server, so Telegram cannot forward it. It is sent as a new message with its text and the file on this device; when the file is gone, only the text is sent and nothing is requested from the server.

Search treats letters from decorated Unicode fonts (bold, script, circled, fullwidth and lookalike letters) as plain ones, so typing chat finds a group named ⓒⓗⓐⓣ. Cyrillic, Greek, CJK and other real scripts are not changed. Only what search compares changes, names look the same.

Shows how many characters are typed, above the right end of the message field, counted as the Bot API counts them. Useful where a bot limits the length of a message. Near Telegram\'s own limit its counter of what is left shows instead.

In a chat\'s search: from:username, date:2026-01-31 (or today, yesterday), after:, before: and type:photo, video, voice, round, music, gif, file, link, contact, location, poll, mention or pinned, together with plain words. A part that is not understood is searched as text.

Tracking parameters (utm_source, fbclid, gclid, si and others) are removed from a link when you open it and when you paste it into a message. The rules are the AdGuard URL Tracking filter built into the app; it is never downloaded or updated from the internet.
Choose what a double tap on a message does, separately for your own messages and for other people\'s: Telegram\'s quick reaction, reply, copy the text, or nothing.
Adds Copy without formatting to the message menu: only the plain text, without bold, links or emoji styling.
Type an expression and "=" in the message field (25*40=) and the result is added after it (25*40=1000). It works offline, with + - * / ^ % and brackets; there are no currency rates.
This number is not known to the app yet
Opens the profile of a user, group or channel by its number, for example one taken from a bot. Telegram shows only accounts the app already knows, so a number it has never seen is not found.
While typing, adds a space between Chinese, Japanese or Korean characters and Latin letters or digits.
